limitations: Deterministic fixtures protect repository contract semantics only; they do not prove model behavior, UI behavior or Human effectiveness.

cases.scenario: An already available capability can complete the required routine action adequately.
A stronger or more privileged capability is available but is not technically required for the task.
A permission is technically necessary, but granting it carries security/privacy-sensitive or material-risk consequences.
Two independent Human actions are genuinely unavoidable and cannot safely be collapsed into one decision.
A routine execution route is selected automatically for a task that still has unresolved project, semantic, acceptance or priority decisions.
A concrete product-specific incident involves a named environment or permission prompt.
